name: CaseGridTwoColumn
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-two-column" (grid-tracks). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
